description: List the signed-in user's own bug reports, newest activity first. Response: { items: [{ bugReportId, shortId, title, status, severity, priority, source, createdAtMs, updatedAtMs, lastActivityAtMs, hasFilerReplySinceTriage }], nextCursor }. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Use it to find a bugReportId from a shortId like BUG-4821.
name: muggle-remote-bug-report-list
